{{Quote|Commander, we're scanning a ship entering the sector.|The technician to Jun Sato|<ref name="Siege of Lothal" />}}
A '''rebel technician''' served under [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]] as part of [[Phoenix Cell]] during the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire]]. Around [[4 BBY]], the officer participated in the [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (3 BBY)|Attack on Phoenix Squadron]]. The [[Rebel technician|technician]] told Sato that a ship was coming in. After losing [[Phoenix One (Siege of Lothal)|Phoenix One]] and [[Phoenix Two]], the ''[[Phoenix Home]]'' lost its hyperdrive to Darth Vader, forcing Sato and the rest of the crew to retreat.<ref name="Siege of Lothal" />
